items.title: Appointment of Luke J. Lindberg as Executive Director of UN World Food Program
items.summary: Office of the Spokesman Appointment of Luke J. Lindberg as Executive Director of UN World Food Program Media Note September 18, 2026 The United States welcomes the Secretary General’s decision to appoint Luke J. Lindberg as Executive Director of the United Nations World Food Program (WFP) in Rome. Since its founding in 1961, the United States has been WFP’s largest donor and strongest advocate. Mr. Lindberg is the right leader to continue this tradition by pursuing reforms that will focus the organization on its core mandate, deliver excellence in operations, and deepen relations with donors.
